common.tagline: Where kids and families learn money and entrepreneurship, the fun way.

confirmation.title: Confirm your email
confirmation.preheader: Confirm your email to start with LittleFounders.
confirmation.heading: Confirm your email
confirmation.body: Welcome to LittleFounders! Confirm this address to activate your account.
confirmation.safety: Didn't sign up? Ignore this email; no account will open.

emailChange.title: Confirm your new email
emailChange.preheader: Confirm your new email for LittleFounders.
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email
emailChange.body: We got a request to move your LittleFounders account to this email.
emailChange.safety: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email and change your password.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.heading: You're invited
invite.body: Join LittleFounders, where families learn money skills together.
invite.safety: Not expecting this? You can ignore this email safely.

magicLink.title: Your sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to LittleFounders
magicLink.body: Tap the button to sign in. No password needed.
magicLink.note: The link works once. If it stops working, ask again.
magicLink.safety: Didn't try to sign in? You can ignore this email.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.body: Tap the button to choose a new password.
recovery.note: The link works once. If it stops working, ask again.
recovery.safety: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email; your password stays the same.
